courses.overview: 從DNS 委派、任播與根服務韌性延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend dns delegation, anycast and root-service resilience to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

place.name: CERN 科學運算城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「全球資訊網早期伺服器系統」共用的資料／元件介面；以「瀏覽服務需名稱解析定位」指出能保留的條件。
針對「DNS 不處理 HTTP 內容與個人會員資料」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with early world wide web server systems; use "Browsing uses names to locate services" to identify retained conditions.
For "DNS does not manage HTTP content or member profiles", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

history.textEn: IANA lists and RFCs distinguish identities, delegations and service requirements; exercises do not scan or modify real infrastructure.
